name: snomed-coder
description: Suggest SNOMED CT codes for a clinical note via retrieval over an illustrative subset — the LLM only picks from retrieved candidates (never hallucinates an id) and abstains. Demo; not for clinical use. FastAPI + Next.js.

paragraphs: Paste a clinical note and get suggested SNOMED codes with the supporting phrase — or an abstention when nothing fits. The model can only pick from retrieved candidates, so it can't invent a code. (First run 10–20s.)
How it works — input → pipeline → output, with the eval harness that measures it:
Demo / educational — not for clinical use. Uses a small illustrative SNOMED subset (not the full release). Output is coding suggestions for a human to confirm.
